name: Gabriel Iglesias
bio: Gabriel Jesus Iglesias (born July 15, 1976), also known as Fluffy, is an American comedian, actor, writer, producer and voice actor. He is known for his shows I'm Not Fat… I'm Fluffy and Hot & Fluffy.
